rationale: A cost-utility analysis needs an effect estimate and utilities that do not exist for this service, and the recorded search found nothing to borrow credibly. What the region can measure now is how the clinic is delivered and what it costs, together with utilities and a concurrent readmission comparison. A hybrid implementation-effectiveness design does both and creates the inputs for an economic evaluation later. Reporting follows StaRI, with CHEERS for the later economic evaluation.
alternatives: Cost-utility model now with borrowed estimates (refused: the effect estimates do not apply to a nurse-led regional clinic)
Randomised trial of the clinic at B and C (deferred: not possible before March 2027 and not yet funded)
Descriptive activity report only (refused: would not create the inputs for valuation)
whyNotMoreComplex: A trial or a full model would promise precision the region cannot deliver by March 2027; the implementation study gives an honest interim answer and the data for a later valuation.

decision.statement: Run a 12-month hybrid implementation study of the Hospital A clinic that measures reach, fidelity and cost per episode, collects utilities, and compares 90-day readmission or death with Hospitals B and C, and tell the finance committee in March 2027 that a credible cost per QALY is not yet possible and will follow these data.
decision.question: What should the region do instead of a cost-utility analysis that the evidence cannot yet support?

criteria.text: Reach, fidelity, costs and utilities can be collected within five minutes per visit.
A published effect estimate applicable to a nurse-led regional clinic is found before the committee meets.

gates.requirement: Regional data office approval for linked admission and cost data for clinic and comparison patients

alternatives: Cost-utility model using published specialist-centre estimates
Fund the clinics at B and C now without evaluation
decision.note: No ledger claim exists because the recorded search returned no records and the investigator confirmed it; the decision rests on the confirmed empty search and the investigator's local facts. The data gate stays unknown until the office replies.

summary: Implementation study recommended instead of an immediate cost-utility analysis; the data gate is unknown.
